verdict.rationale: Fireworks ships an official CLI, firectl. The docs show it creating deployments with a single command and configuring autoscaling through firectl flags. The docs also mention a first-party Nexus CLI for connecting coding tools to Fireworks models. Missing for 10: installation and command-reference documentation, evidence of agent-friendly features (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
